# Emit and publish wiki and embeddings post-persist

After a successful persist, the runner emits wiki pages for changed entities, may generate embeddings for changed content, and optionally publishes the wiki to a git branch. Failures in these steps are captured as warnings and do not roll back the persisted compile.
